title: Crisp Vegetable Spring Rolls
description: A popular chinese snack of crunchy vegetables wrapped in a thin dough, served with a sweet and sour sauce. Perfect for any occasion.

ingredients.name: Crisp spring roll wrappers
ingredients.notes: available at most chinese grocery stores

instructions: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Cut the spring roll wrappers into square shapes.
Place a tablespoon of vegetable mixture in the center of each wrapper.
Brush the edges with water and fold the wrapper into a triangle, pressing the edges together to seal.
Fry the spring rolls until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve with hoisin sauce and sumac.
Garnish with additional sumac and serve immediately.
